 Love the look of stars’ cloud couches? Shop similar designs for less at Wayfair’s big sale 
 By 
 Hannah Southwick 
 Published 
 Oct. 24, 2026, 10:00 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Want the cloud couch look, without the sky-high prices? 
 Wayfair 
 Page Six may be compensated and/or receive an affiliate commission if you click or buy through our links. Featured pricing is subject to change.
 The cloud couches celebrities love aren’t in everyone’s budget — but there’s a silver lining. 
 During Wayfair’s huge semi-annual Way Day sale , we spotted deals on several that look strikingly similar to the trendy Restoration Hardware couch stars like Kendall Jenner, Kerry Washington and Naomi Watts own. 
 Below, shop a few top picks that get great reviews from shoppers. (Way Day goes until Oct. 26.)
 Latitude Run Cloud Modular Sectional Sofa 
 Latitude Run 
 At 61% off, this gorgeous cloud-like couch doesn’t have a sky-high price tag. It even comes with fully removable, washable covers. 
 BUY NOW $1,899.99 $759.99 
 Ivy Bronx Nerio Boneless Foam Sofa 
 Wayfair 
 This sleek design is also nearly 60% off already (even if you’re not a Wayfair member). And while it looks incredibly modern and clean, it’s not all style and no substance. 
 Reviewers call it things like “good quality” and “strong and sturdy, but super easy to set up.”
 BUY NOW $1,197.00 $489.00 
 Mercer31 Modern Upholstered Sofa 
 Wayfair 
 This curved sofa is “Wayfair verified,” meaning it’s been evaluated by Wayfair’s in-house product specialists — and selected as a top pick for great quality and value. It also gets glowing reviews from shoppers, as it has an average of 4.4 stars out of nearly 400 reviews.
 BUY NOW $499.99 $459.99 
 Wrought Studio Curved Sofa 
 Wrought Studio 
 The high-density foam in this four-seater chenille sofa ensures “perfect contouring to your body shape,” according to the brand. 
 BUY NOW $580.00 $530.00 
 Lattitude Run Alyciana Upholstered Sectional 
 Wayfair 
 Keeping a white sofa clean can be tricky — but the zippered pillow covers on this upholstered sectional make it a whole lot easier. It has 175 five-star reviews, calling it things like “comfy and cute.” 
 “It feels like I’m sitting on a cloud!” one satisfied shopper even wrote.
 BUY NOW $1,299.99 $1,219.99 
 Wade Logan Croley Upholstered Sofa 
 Wayfair 
 For a more standard take on a neutral-colored couch, this timeless design also scored Wayfair’s “verified” badge. In addition to white, it also comes in seven other chenille colors — so you can find a fit for practically any home.
 BUY NOW $568.74 $489.99
